recipe.title: sqlalchemy-mixins: migrate to SQLAlchemy 2.0
recipe.notes: The spec (requirements.txt, 'sqlalchemy >= 1.0') already admits 2.0, so the pre-upgrade lock is held below 2 as upstream's CI ran it; upstream's commit raises it to >= 2.0. Python 3.11: SQLAlchemy 1.4.47 (April 2023) has no 3.12 wheels. Tests are unittest classes, run with pytest.

reason: 6 of 21 base tests (28.6%) fail with upstream's own code on SQLAlchemy 2 (upstream rewrote them): over the 20% exclusion cap (the lead's call: borderline counts as rejected while 6+ strict instances remain).

recipe.title: wtforms-sqlalchemy: SQLAlchemy 2.0 compatibility
recipe.notes: The requirement (SQLAlchemy>=0.7.10) already admits 2.0; the pre-upgrade lock is held below 2. Licence: BSD (LICENSE.txt; GitHub does not classify it). Resolved as of 2024-01-15: SQLAlchemy 1.4's macOS wheels for the release current at the upgrade were only uploaded in January 2024.

reason: No hidden tests: upstream's change touched no test file.

recipe.title: rich-click: fix click 8.3 incompatibility
recipe.notes: The requirement (click>=8) already admits 8.3; the pre-upgrade lock is held below 8.3. Test requirements from the dev extra (the test tooling only); pyproject's addopts turn coverage on, so it is turned off (--no-cov). The project is installed for each test run (its subprocess tests import it with their own PYTHONPATH), as its CI does; TERM and COLUMNS are left unset, as on CI.

reason: Nothing breaks on marshmallow 4.0 final: the only failing tests test marshmallow 3's behaviour and fail with upstream's code too (a bare version bump would pass).
Its spec needs fugue-sql-antlr, which had no wheels at the time; environments are wheels-only (members need no compiler).
Upstream's merge changes only the spec, the version and the tests: a bare version bump suffices.
